title: TRID Compliance Manual — Initial Loan Estimate Delivery and Receipt for the Mortgage Loan File
content:
**Application date.** An application on a Mortgage Loan File exists once all six TRID items are received — the borrower's name, income, Social Security number, the property address, the estimated value and the loan amount; that date is the file's application date.

**Delivery deadline.** The initial Loan Estimate must be delivered or placed in the mail no later than the end of the delivery window that starts on the application date. Business days are counted forward from the application date, which is day zero; the issued date may be any day up to and including the last business day of the window. The window is the program's Loan Estimate delivery period in business days. A business day is Monday through Friday excluding the US federal public holidays observed by the Federal Reserve Banks; Saturdays, Sundays and those holidays are skipped when counting.

**Status and sequence.** An initial Loan Estimate is issued only while the loan file status is application received. The initial Loan Estimate carries disclosure sequence 1. Issuing the initial Loan Estimate moves the file to disclosed. A file whose application is denied or withdrawn before the delivery deadline does not receive a Loan Estimate.

**Receipt.** Receipt is the e-sign acknowledgment date for delivery through the e-sign portal and the in-person date for in-person delivery; a mailed Loan Estimate is deemed received on the specific business day after the issued date that the mailbox rule names (the program's mailbox rule count), where a specific business day is every calendar day except Sundays and the US federal public holidays.

The evidence for the deadline is the application date recorded on the file and the file's status, not the borrower's account of when the application was made.

## Delivery deadline, worked through (hypothetical dates, 3-business-day window, no holidays in the period)

| Application date | Last business day of the window | Loan Estimate issued on | Timely |
|---|---|---|---|
| Monday | Thursday (Tuesday 1, Wednesday 2, Thursday 3) | Thursday | yes — the last day is included |
| Monday | Thursday | Friday | no |
| Thursday | following Tuesday (Friday 1, Monday 2, Tuesday 3) | Tuesday | yes |

## Mailed receipt, worked through (hypothetical, mailbox rule of 3, no holidays)

A Loan Estimate placed in the mail on a Friday is deemed received on the following Tuesday: Saturday is the first specific business day, Sunday is skipped, Monday is the second and Tuesday the third.
